title: Media Production Specialist (Louisiana Conference of The United Methodist Church)
org: Louisiana Conference of The United Methodist Church
summary: Full-time role managing day-to-day video, photography and podcast production, operating professional equipment, editing, and leading production at major events. Occasional travel within Louisiana. Apply through the PayCom portal on the listing.
